title: ManifestLock: say so when waiting on another csnotes process
description:
ManifestLock::acquire (src/manifest.rs ~L373) does a blocking flock(LOCK_EX), so if another csnotes process holds .csnotes.lock (e.g. an open process session in another pane) the command hangs silently and looks frozen.

Fix: try flock(LOCK_EX | LOCK_NB) first; on EWOULDBLOCK print a dim stderr line like 'waiting for another csnotes process to release the vault lock… (ctrl+c to abort)' then fall back to blocking LOCK_EX. Covers all 10 acquire() call sites at once. Pairs with the spinner issue (spinner can wrap the blocking wait).

Test: hold the lock in-thread via a second fd, assert acquire() from another thread emits the message / succeeds after release.

Context: 2026-10-21 reconcile 'lag' investigation. Couldn't reproduce (reconcile ~0.05s on real vault); likely causes were first-run Gatekeeper scan of fresh binary, this silent lock wait, or iCloud-evicted files in ~/Documents/Vault/SU.
